note: Local governments whose chief executive is the state-level executive office of the same place, so the state's executive holder signs or vetoes the government's acts. Keyed by municipal government key. Read September 29, 2026.

us-dc-washington.citation: District of Columbia Home Rule Act § 422, D.C. Code § 1-204.22: the Mayor is the chief executive officer of the District government, and the District's executive office is the Mayor's.
